sentences.latin: Actum quem debuisti, mi Secunde, in excutiendis causis eorum, qui Christiani ad te delati fuerant, secutus es.
sentences.english: You have followed the procedure, my Secundus, that you ought to have followed in examining the cases of those who had been brought before you as Christians.

sentences.latin: Neque enim in universum aliquid, quod quasi certam formam habeat, constitui potest.
sentences.english: For nothing can be laid down as a general rule which has, so to speak, a fixed form.

sentences.latin: Conquirendi non sunt; si deferantur et arguantur, puniendi sunt, ita tamen ut, qui negaverit se Christianum esse idque re ipsa manifestum fecerit, id est supplicando dis nostris, quamvis suspectus in praeteritum, veniam ex paenitentia impetret.
sentences.english: They are not to be hunted out; if they are brought before you and convicted, they are to be punished, but in such a way that one who denies that he is a Christian and makes this clear by the very deed itself, that is, by supplicating our gods, although suspect with regard to the past, may obtain pardon through repentance.

sentences.latin: Sine auctore vero propositi libelli in nullo crimine locum habere debent.
sentences.english: But anonymous documents put forward should have no place in any charge.

sentences.latin: Nam et pessimi exempli nec nostri saeculi est.
sentences.english: For it is both of the worst precedent and not in keeping with our age.
